failures.question: 每个月的订单量，以及相比上个月的变化量是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp)
),
monthly_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    order_count,
    order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_prev_month
  FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
  month,
  order_count,
  COALESCE(change_from_prev_month, 0) AS change_from_prev_month
FROM monthly_changes
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 24;

failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH orders_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
),
orders_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(o2018.month, o2017.month) AS month,
  o2017.order_count AS orders_2017,
  o2018.order_count AS orders_2018,
  (o2018.order_count - o2017.order_count) AS growth
FROM orders_2017 o2017
FULL OUTER JOIN orders_2018 o2018 ON o2017.month = o2018.month
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;

    date_trunc('week', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS week,
    SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) AS weekly_sales

    o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (

failures.question: 每个州的平均配送时长是多少天？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_state AS state,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN 
    sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE 
    o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY

LIMIT 1000;
